title: OLD (unversioned, no marker) files read by NEW (POSITIVE control)

legacy_observed.behaviour: v0 -> v1 migration in place; legacy state owning lots -> install_mismatch, entries paused until THIS_ACCOUNT

nc02_required.R-GEN-MONOTONIC: every store write carries (generation, writer_build, format_version, min_reader_version); a reader that sees a generation written by a newer build, or a lower generation than the highest it has seen (rollback/stale copy), aborts read-only (R-ABORT-RO)
nc02_required.R-RECON-GATE: management (and every new-risk path, MANUAL included) stays blocked until a reconciliation record binds state generation G to an exchange snapshot that matches it (positions, open orders, protective orders) or the owner adopts/flattens each difference explicitly; resuming entries alone never clears it
